name: Death of Obsidian Butterflies
description: Conjures a cascade of razor-sharp obsidian butterflies that slash everyone in a roughly 10-yard area; defended against as a hand-to-hand attack with the caster's Perception + Occult successes.

name: Demon of the First Circle
description: Summons and binds a first-circle demon to the sorcerer's service over a night's ritual begun at sunset.

name: Emerald Countermagic
description: Dispels Terrestrial Circle sorcery; can also be used to counter a spell as it is cast.

name: Impenetrable Frost Barrier
description: Raises a barrier of intense magical cold that damages and hampers those who try to cross it.

name: Infallible Messenger
description: Sends a short spoken message to anyone the sorcerer has met, delivered by a tiny figure of Essence.

name: Invulnerable Skin of Bronze
description: Hardens the sorcerer's skin to add +6 soak against lethal damage and +12 against bashing.

name: Stormwind Rider
description: Wraps the sorcerer in a controllable dust-devil vortex that carries her at great speed and cushions falls.

name: Summon Elemental
description: Summons and binds an elemental to service; like Demon of the First Circle but castable any time and with gentler terms.

name: Sworn Brothers' Oath

cost.raw: 10 motes + 1 mote from each Exalted bound by the spell

description: Binds the Essence of two or more Exalted (of any type) into a sworn brotherhood over an hour-long ritual (one additional hour per Exalt beyond the first two); the sorcerer need not be one of the bound. The caster's Intelligence + Occult successes set the brotherhood's level, which drives three linked effects: Loyalty (a Conviction roll beating that level is needed to act to harm a sworn sibling), Devotion (a once-per-story bonus dice pool equal to the oathbond rating when aiding a sworn sibling), and Familiarity (each knows a sworn sibling's location within rating x 10 yards, or its direction on an Essence roll beyond that).

name: Wood Dragon's Claw
description: Transforms the hands into gnarled oaken claws dealing Strength + 4 lethal damage and able to block lethal attacks.

name: Blood of Boiling Oil
description: Hurls a sphere of searing Essence that boils a living victim's blood, dealing aggravated damage.

name: Demon of the Second Circle
description: Summons and binds a more powerful second-circle demon; similar to Demon of the First Circle but mightier and more dangerous.

name: Dolorous Reflection
description: A defensive nimbus of mystical energy that reflects ranged and hand-to-hand attacks back at the attacker.

name: Incomparable Body Arsenal
description: Grows the sorcerer's body into a living arsenal of blades and barbs, raising Strength and Stamina and dealing lethal damage.

name: Sapphire Countermagic
description: Dispels Celestial Circle (and lower) sorcery; can also counter a spell as it is cast.

name: Travel Without Distance
description: Instantly transports the sorcerer across any distance to a place she can clearly picture.

name: Adamant Countermagic
description: The most powerful countermagic; dispels sorcery of any circle up to and including the Solar Circle, and protects against lower-circle countermagic.

name: Demon of the Third Circle
description: Summons and binds one of the mighty third-circle demon princes; an extremely difficult and dangerous ritual.

name: Rain of Doom
description: Calls down a corrosive, venomous rain over a vast area that sears and poisons everything it touches.

name: Rune of Singular Hate
description: A single spoken word of pure malice that strips dots from every Ability, Attribute, and Virtue of its target; the sorcerer also permanently loses one dot from each of her own.

name: Hungry Creeping Shadow
description: Vomits forth a creature of liquid shadow that pursues one target in sight; it has Physical Attributes and Brawl equal to the caster's Essence and Stamina+Essence health levels, ignores kinetic damage, and clinches to crush its prey. Lasts one hour.

name: Iron Countermagic
description: Necromantic countermagic: 10 motes raises a personal shield negating hostile Shadowlands spells until the next turn's end (−2 to Physical actions while it persists); 20 motes extinguishes one Shadowlands spell within Essence×50 feet. May also oppose sorcery one circle higher.

name: Piercing the Shroud
description: A ten-minute chant (minus the caster's Occult) ends with a blade-cut in the air that tears open a rift to the Labyrinth for Essence turns. Only lets a necromancer enter — she must find her own way out.

name: Raise the Skeletal Horde
description: Jagged Essence-lightning animates nearby corpses within 100 yards as common zombies (extras): one per 5 motes (permanent), or one per 3 motes for temporary zombies that fall at scene's end. Cannot mix permanent and temporary in one casting.

name: Rune of Sweet Passing
description: An hour-long ritual paints a mortal's skin with blood-and-grave-soil glyphs that ensure she becomes a ghost upon death and alert the necromancer the instant she dies. Creates ghosts only; no control over them. No effect on Exalted or magical beings.

name: Shade Prison Amulet
description: Enchants a piece of bone jewelry to trap one hungry ghost it touches, holding it so long as the talisman is intact; breaking the prison frees the ghost (destroyed if broken by daylight). The Labyrinth version, Bauble of the Captive Soul, catches any ghost for 15 motes.

name: Soul Brand
description: Tattoos an unExalted mortal with a permanent rune granting the protection of a Ghost-Warding Glyph; removing it burns the mortal for the necromancer's Essence in lethal dice. Vanishes harmlessly if the bearer ever Exalts.

name: Summon Ghost
description: An hour-long night/Underworld ritual (needs the ghost's name or a piece of her corpse) tears a portal for 10 motes; each extra 5 motes weakens the ghost by a die. An opposed Willpower+Essence contest binds her to a year-and-a-day of service, or she escapes for a year.

name: Walking War Machine
description: Animates a pre-built undead siege engine (extended Intelligence+Craft (Necrosurgery) to construct): touching it and investing 5 motes per assembly success sets it serving its master. Spine-chain statistics on Exalted p300.

name: Exquisite Undead Aide
description: Raises a single capable servant instead of a horde: a common zombie whose non-Appearance Attributes are at least 2, with Intelligence+Occult in Ability dots (none above the caster's own). Never decays, can speak in clipped phrases, and has full health levels.

name: Hundred Shade Breath
description: Exhales a blue fog that coalesces into hungry ghosts (extras), one per 2 motes, over the next turn. Useless by day (sunlight burns them to ash); survivors dissolve back into the caster at scene's end, freeing 2 committed motes per ghost lost.

name: Ivory Razor Forest
description: A shockwave of Essence raises dense spines of bone (max height Essence yards) over (Charisma+Occult)×10 square yards of any shape, inflicting unblockable 8L (dodge only) to all within and to anything hurled against them. The spikes last for Essence days.

name: Reaping the Fallen
description: Flares the caster's anima to full and, for the rest of the scene, grants 1 mote for every sentient being that dies within a league (up to her maximum). The Void version, Blood from the Slaughter (35 motes), instead regenerates a health level per kill.

name: Spiteful Passing
description: A dying necromancer's final blast: after a turn concentrating, he expires as searing light, dealing everyone within Stamina yards his Essence in lethal dice plus one per remaining mote, bypassing armor (natural soak only). All plants within range wither; his corpse crumbles to dust.

name: Stealing the Gathered Breath
description: Inhales the life energy of every sentient being within Essence×5 yards, inflicting one lethal die (Stamina soak only) on each; every level actually dealt restores 1 mote to the necromancer.

name: Striking Spectre Lash
description: Grows a whip of solidified darkness with Speed/Accuracy/Defense equal to Essence, reach four times that, and Strength+Essence base damage that can grapple and kill at range. Reflexively spending 2 motes on a hit forces an Essence roll or the mortal victim drops dead.

name: Abyssal Aegis
description: Until next sunrise, grants bashing and lethal soak equal to permanent Essence and negates any magic designed to deal extra damage or trauma to Abyssals, Deathlords, or Underworld denizens — the bonus effect vanishes, though the base attack still lands.

name: Anguished Shade Harvest
description: Pacing a boundary on foot from sunset to before midnight consecrates that land to the Underworld: black clouds shroud it, and any mortal who dies violently there afterward rises at dusk as an uncontrolled hungry ghost (extra).

name: Blood Monsoon
description: A geyser of the caster's blood builds over an hour into a mile-high cloud covering Essence miles in radius, then rains gore for Stamina hours — killing plants and small animals, sickening others (hourly Stamina+Endurance check), and drawing malevolent creatures for miles.

name: Dimming of the Light
description: A sunset-to-midnight ritual transforms a willing Solar into an Abyssal: she renounces her god, Caste Mark, Charms, and name, and at midnight her anima is swallowed by shadow. She gains matching Abyssal Charms and caste (Dawn→Dusk, etc.) and is thereafter a deathknight.

name: Inauspicious Citadel
description: After sacrificing at least 100 mortals into a pit dug in a shadowland and bleeding a health level into it, the earth falls away to the Labyrinth and a unique defensible fortress of obsidian and black basalt grinds up, its lowest chapel opening onto the dead gods below.

name: Lord of the Dead
description: For a full day the caster's Caste Mark glows red, letting her command any ghost, walking dead, or creature of death of lower permanent Essence, and barring any such creature from attacking her. No power over Abyssal Exalted or Deathlords.

name: Poisoning the Well
description: Fasting at a Demesne's heart for days equal to its rating dooms it to lose a rating point each month until, at zero, it shifts to an Abyssal aspect and slowly regains strength. Only Adamant Countermagic (at double cost) or an Incarna can arrest the decay.
